home.title: Let’s analyze your image!
home.subtitle: Upload a SAR or optical capture and ask anything about what it shows.
home.addSecond: Add a second image (optical+SAR pair or before/after)
home.browseHint: or click to browse — one image, or two for a cross-modal / bi-temporal pair
home.imagesHelp: Required. One georeferenced GeoTIFF (.tif/.tiff), or two for a co-registered optical+SAR pair or before/after comparison — each up to {{size}}.
home.promptPlaceholder: e.g. How many ships are docked in the harbour?
home.promptHint: Write in English or any of the 22 Indian languages. Your question is translated to English for the models, and the answer is translated back.
home.example1: Which areas in this image are flooded?
home.example2: What changed between these two dates?
home.example3: Describe the land cover in this scene.
home.genericError: Something went wrong running the analysis.
home.running: Routing the query and running the selected specialist…

errors.imageRequired: At least one image is required to run an analysis.
